exam_set.title: Practice Set 4
exam_set.description: Textbook Practice — Book 1, Chapter 10, Practice Set 4

questions.jp: LANにおいて、伝送距離を延長するために伝送路の途中でデータの信号波形を増幅・整形して、物理層での中継を行う装置はどれか。
questions.romaji: LAN ni oite, densō kyori o enchō suru tame ni densōro no tochū de dēta no shingō hakei o zōfuku-seikei shite, butsuri-sō de no chūkei o okonau sōchi wa dore ka.
questions.en: In a LAN, which device regenerates and reshapes signals mid-link to extend distance and relays at the physical layer?

options.label: ア
options.jp: スイッチングハブ（レイヤー2スイッチ）

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
A repeater cleans up a weakening signal and sends it onward.

Technical breakdown:
A repeater operates at OSI Layer 1. It regenerates, amplifies, and reshapes physical signals to overcome attenuation and extend a segment's transmission distance.

Japanese keywords to remember:
信号波形 = shingō hakei = signal waveform
物理層 = butsuri-sō = physical layer

Why the best solution works:
ウ is the Layer 1 relay device described.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
A Layer 2 switch forwards frames based on MAC addresses.
イ:
A bridge also relays at the data-link layer.
エ:
A router forwards packets at the network layer.

Memory trick:
Repeater repeats bits at Layer 1.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: 複数のLANを接続するために用いる装置で、OSI基本参照モデルのデータリンク層のプロトコル情報に基づいてデータを中継する装置はどれか。
questions.romaji: Fukusū no LAN o setsuzoku suru tame ni mochiiru sōchi de, OSI kihon sanshō moderu no dēta rinku-sō no purotokoru jōhō ni motozuite dēta o chūkei suru sōchi wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which device connects multiple LANs and relays data using protocol information at the OSI data-link layer?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
A bridge joins LAN sections and decides frame forwarding from Layer 2 information.

Technical breakdown:
A bridge operates at the data-link layer, learns MAC addresses, and filters or forwards frames between LAN segments.

Japanese keywords to remember:
データリンク層 = dēta rinku-sō = data-link layer
中継 = chūkei = relay

Why the best solution works:
イ is the classic Layer 2 LAN interconnection device.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
A gateway can translate protocols at higher layers.
ウ:
A repeater works at the physical layer without Layer 2 interpretation.
エ:
A router uses network-layer IP information.

Memory trick:
Bridge = Layer 2 bridge between LANs.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: 二つのLANセグメントを接続する装置Aの機能をTCP/IPの階層モデルで表すと図のようになる。この装置Aはどれか。図では、装置Aがインターネット層、リンク層、ハードウェア層をもち、二つのLANセグメント間でデータを中継している。
questions.romaji: Futatsu no LAN segumento o setsuzoku suru sōchi A no kinō o TCP/IP no kaisō moderu de arawasu to zu no yō ni naru. Kono sōchi A wa dore ka. Zu de wa, sōchi A ga intānetto-sō, rinku-sō, hādowea-sō o mochi, futatsu no LAN segumento-kan de dēta o chūkei shite iru.
questions.en: Device A connects two LAN segments. The diagram shows it implementing the Internet, link, and hardware layers to relay data between them. What is device A?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
The diagram reaches the Internet layer, so the device makes IP-level forwarding decisions: a router.

Technical breakdown:
In the TCP/IP model, the Internet layer corresponds to OSI's network layer and handles IP packet routing. A device terminating link/hardware processing on both interfaces and forwarding at the Internet layer is a router.

Japanese keywords to remember:
階層モデル = kaisō moderu = layered model
インターネット層 = intānetto-sō = Internet layer

Why the best solution works:
エ is the only option whose forwarding function reaches the Internet layer shown.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
A switching hub forwards at the link layer.
イ:
A bridge also operates at the link layer.
ウ:
A repeater hub operates only at the hardware/physical layer.

Memory trick:
Internet layer in device → router.

Correct answer: エ

questions.jp: ルーターがパケットの経路決定に用いる情報として、最も適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Rūtā ga paketto no keiro kettei ni mochiiru jōhō to shite, mottomo tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which information is most appropriate for a router to use when deciding a packet's route?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
A router looks at where the packet must go, then chooses the best matching network route.

Technical breakdown:
Standard IP forwarding performs longest-prefix matching between the destination IP address and routing-table prefixes. MAC addresses apply only to delivery on the current link and change hop by hop.

Japanese keywords to remember:
経路決定 = keiro kettei = route decision
宛先IPアドレス = atesaki IP adoresu = destination IP address

Why the best solution works:
ア supplies the network-layer destination used for route lookup.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
Destination MAC identifies the next-hop interface on a local link, not the end-to-end route.
ウ:
Ordinary forwarding is not selected from the source IP address.
エ:
Source MAC identifies the sender on the current link only.

Memory trick:
Router routes toward destination IP.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: OSI基本参照モデルにおけるネットワーク層の説明として、適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: OSI kihon sanshō moderu ni okeru nettowāku-sō no setsumei to shite, tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which correctly describes the network layer in the OSI reference model?

options.label: ア
options.jp: エンドシステム間のデータ伝送を実現するために、ルーティングや中継などを行う。
options.romaji: Endo shisutemu-kan no dēta densō o jitsugen suru tame ni, rūtingu ya chūkei nado o okonau.
options.en: Perform routing and relaying to provide data transmission between end systems.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 各層のうち、最も利用者に近い部分であり、ファイル転送や電子メールなどの機能が実現されている。
options.romaji: Kakusō no uchi, mottomo riyōsha ni chikai bubun de ari, fairu tensō ya denshi mēru nado no kinō ga jitsugen sarete iru.
options.en: Be the layer closest to users, implementing file transfer and email.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 物理的な通信媒体の特性の差を吸収し、上位の層に透過的な伝送路を提供する。
options.romaji: Butsuriteki na tsūshin baitai no tokusei no sa o kyūshū shi, jōi no sō ni tōkateki na densōro o teikyō suru.
options.en: Hide differences in physical media and provide a transparent link to upper layers.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 隣接ノード間の伝送制御手順（誤り検出、再送制御など）を提供する。
options.romaji: Rinsetsu nōdo-kan no densō seigyo tejun (ayamari kenshutsu, saisō seigyo nado) o teikyō suru.
options.en: Provide transmission-control procedures between adjacent nodes, including error detection and retransmission.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
The network layer chooses paths across multiple networks so one end system can reach another.

Technical breakdown:
OSI Layer 3 provides logical addressing, routing, and packet forwarding across intermediate nodes for end-to-end system connectivity.

Japanese keywords to remember:
ネットワーク層 = nettowāku-sō = network layer
ルーティング = rūtingu = routing

Why the best solution works:
ア states the network layer's routing and relay responsibility.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
This describes the application layer.
ウ:
This describes the data-link layer's abstraction over physical media.
エ:
Adjacent-node error and retransmission control belongs to the data-link layer.

Memory trick:
Layer 3 = route between networks.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: メディアコンバータ、リピータハブ、レイヤー2スイッチ、レイヤー3スイッチのうち、レイヤー3スイッチだけがもつ機能はどれか。
questions.romaji: Media konbāta, ripīta habu, reiyā 2 suicchi, reiyā 3 suicchi no uchi, reiyā 3 suicchi dake ga motsu kinō wa dore ka.
questions.en: Among a media converter, repeater hub, Layer 2 switch, and Layer 3 switch, which function belongs only to the Layer 3 switch?

options.label: ア
options.jp: データリンク層において、宛先アドレスに従って適切なLANポートにパケットを中継する機能
options.romaji: Dēta rinku-sō ni oite, atesaki adoresu ni shitagatte tekisetsu na LAN pōto ni paketto o chūkei suru kinō
options.en: At the data-link layer, relay packets to an appropriate LAN port according to destination address.

options.label: イ
options.jp: ネットワーク層において、宛先アドレスに従って適切なLANポートにパケットを中継する機能
options.romaji: Nettowāku-sō ni oite, atesaki adoresu ni shitagatte tekisetsu na LAN pōto ni paketto o chūkei suru kinō
options.en: At the network layer, relay packets to an appropriate LAN port according to destination address.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 物理層において、異なる伝送媒体を接続し、信号を相互に変換する機能
options.romaji: Butsuri-sō ni oite, kotonaru densō baitai o setsuzoku shi, shingō o sōgo ni henkan suru kinō
options.en: At the physical layer, connect different transmission media and convert signals between them.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 物理層において、入力信号を全てのLANポートに対して中継する機能
options.romaji: Butsuri-sō ni oite, nyūryoku shingō o subete no LAN pōto ni taishite chūkei suru kinō
options.en: At the physical layer, relay an input signal to every LAN port.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Layer 3 switch uniquely makes network-layer IP forwarding decisions; other listed devices stop at Layer 2 or Layer 1.

Technical breakdown:
A Layer 3 switch combines switching hardware with network-layer routing. It selects an output port from destination IP/network information. A Layer 2 switch uses MAC addresses, a media converter changes physical media, and a repeater hub repeats signals.

Japanese keywords to remember:
レイヤー3スイッチ = reiyā 3 suicchi = Layer 3 switch
宛先アドレス = atesaki adoresu = destination address

Why the best solution works:
イ is network-layer forwarding, unique among the four listed device types.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Layer 2 switches also perform data-link-layer forwarding.
ウ:
This is a media converter's function.
エ:
This is a repeater hub's function.

Memory trick:
Only L3 switch routes by IP.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: OSI基本参照モデルのトランスポート層以上が異なるLANシステム相互間でプロトコル変換を行う機器はどれか。
questions.romaji: OSI kihon sanshō moderu no toransupōto-sō ijō ga kotonaru LAN shisutemu sōgo-kan de purotokoru henkan o okonau kiki wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which device performs protocol conversion between LAN systems that differ at the OSI transport layer or above?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
A gateway translates between unlike higher-layer communication languages.

Technical breakdown:
A gateway can terminate and translate protocols at transport, session, presentation, or application layers. Bridge, repeater, and router relay at Layers 2, 1, and 3 respectively without general higher-layer protocol conversion.

Japanese keywords to remember:
プロトコル変換 = purotokoru henkan = protocol conversion
トランスポート層以上 = toransupōto-sō ijō = transport layer or above

Why the best solution works:
ア is the device category for higher-layer protocol translation.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
A bridge forwards data-link frames.
ウ:
A repeater regenerates physical signals.
エ:
A router forwards network-layer packets.

Memory trick:
Gateway translates protocols.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: TCP/IPのネットワークにおいて、サーバとクライアント間で時刻を合わせるためのプロトコルはどれか。
questions.romaji: TCP/IP no nettowāku ni oite, sāba to kuraianto-kan de jikoku o awaseru tame no purotokoru wa dore ka.
questions.en: In a TCP/IP network, which protocol synchronizes time between server and client?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
NTP lets computers compare clocks with time servers and adjust them.

Technical breakdown:
Network Time Protocol exchanges timestamped messages and estimates delay/offset to synchronize client clocks with network time servers.

Japanese keywords to remember:
時刻を合わせる = jikoku o awaseru = synchronize time
サーバとクライアント間 = sāba to kuraianto-kan = between server and client

Why the best solution works:
ウ is specifically designed for network clock synchronization.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
ARP resolves IPv4 addresses to link-layer addresses.
イ:
ICMP carries IP control and error messages.
エ:
RIP exchanges routing information.

Memory trick:
NTP = Network Time Protocol.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: インターネットにおける電子メールの規約で、ヘッダーフィールドの拡張を行い、テキストだけでなく、音声、画像なども扱えるようにしたものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Intānetto ni okeru denshi mēru no kiyaku de, heddā fīrudo no kakuchō o okonai, tekisuto dake de naku, onsei, gazō nado mo atsukaeru yō ni shita mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which Internet email standard extends header fields so email can handle audio, images, and more, not just text?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
MIME labels the type and encoding of email parts, letting messages carry images, audio, and attachments.

Technical breakdown:
Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions adds Content-Type, Content-Transfer-Encoding, multipart boundaries, and related headers. These extend Internet mail beyond original limited text bodies.

Japanese keywords to remember:
ヘッダーフィールドの拡張 = heddā fīrudo no kakuchō = header-field extension
音声、画像 = onsei, gazō = audio and images

Why the best solution works:
ウ is the standard explicitly created for multimedia and multipart email content.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
HTML formats hypertext but is not the email extension standard described.
イ:
MHS is a general message-handling-system concept, not these Internet mail extensions.
エ:
SMTP transports mail but does not define multimedia body encoding.

Memory trick:
MIME = multimedia mail types.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: 電子メールを暗号化するために使用される方式はどれか。
questions.romaji: Denshi mēru o angōka suru tame ni shiyō sareru hōshiki wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which method is used to encrypt electronic mail?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
S/MIME uses certificates and cryptography to protect email content.

Technical breakdown:
Secure/Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions provides public-key-based encryption and digital signatures for MIME email. It protects confidentiality and can also provide integrity and sender authentication.

Japanese keywords to remember:
電子メール = denshi mēru = electronic mail
暗号化 = angōka = encryption

Why the best solution works:
エ is the secure email format that supports encryption.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Base64 is reversible binary-to-text encoding, not encryption.
イ:
GZIP compresses data; it provides no confidentiality.
ウ:
PNG is an image format, not an email encryption method.

Memory trick:
S in S/MIME = secure mail.

Correct answer: エ
